# mapbox/earcut.hpp

Vendored, unmodified header-only polygon triangulator from
[`mapbox/earcut.hpp`](https://github.com/mapbox/earcut.hpp), ISC licensed.

The copy was imported for the vector-overlay implementation on 2026-07-30 from
the upstream-compatible header used by the local `dtcc-core` checkout. It matches
the mapbox/earcut.hpp 1.0-era single-header API (`mapbox::earcut`). Update only by
replacing the header as a whole and recording the upstream commit SHA here.
